coverage_assessment: Bounded open-web first pass: 36 registered search invocations with 903 ordered headers/URLs, including single and batched queries in English, French, German and Luxembourgish and week/date plus sector searches. The rollout reconciliation matches every action ID, exact query, timestamp, ordered header and URL array. 18 exact-URL cards comprise 1 opened written article and 17 search-only leads. Three provisional candidates remain pending evidence; there is no supported qualifying threshold/state-demand record, no established continuation and no confidently excluded action. LexisNexis/systematic local archive coverage and the official baseline remain unavailable; no completeness or non-occurrence claim is made.
